task_definition.task_name: DAS Data Strain-to-Velocity Conversion via FK Rescaling

task_description.overview: Convert distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) strain data to particle velocity by applying FK-domain rescaling with apparent phase velocity.
steps: Load the preprocessed DAS strain Section object from the provided pickle file.
Compute the FK transform of the strain Section.
Multiply each FK-domain coefficient by its corresponding apparent phase velocity (slope).
Inverse FK-transform the rescaled data to obtain velocity time series for each channel.
Extract the velocity trace for the target channel for further analysis.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Using daspy package to load the DAS strain Section from {das_section_path}, and using `fk_rescaling(fmax=({fmax}))` to convert the strain to velocity. Then select the {show_channel} to compare the transformed velocity data with the original node seismometer data (loaded from {node_seismometer_path}), and enlarge the time range to show the P-wave and S-wave. Note: 1) consider using daspy package to load, process (e.g. fk_rescaling, etc.). 2) Save the result into a pickle file {result_data} and the figure {result_figure}.
